body.title: docs/daemon.md and the documentation test
body.summary: Document the root schemaVersion, the boot migration and the comparison rule (absent, null or below applies, equal or above does nothing, an invalid value runs nothing, a failed step is retried next boot, a manual repo.buildDefaults.migrate does not touch the version and a deliberate clear is not re-applied at boot once stamped, lowering or removing the value re-runs the pending steps) in docs/daemon.md, and extend build-commands-doc.test.ts with a test that reads the constant and statuses from the code and fails when the doc names a different file or rule. The paragraph must keep the existing DOC_JSON_NAMES and FILE_MENTION_CONTEXT pins passing.
acceptanceChecks: docs/daemon.md describes the schemaVersion at the root of repo-config.json and the boot migration in line with the code
build-commands-doc.test.ts passes, including the three existing tests, and fails when the doc names a different file or an invalid rule

tests.name: build-commands-doc.test.ts: docs/daemon.md describes the schemaVersion at the root of repo-config.json and the boot migration in line with the code
